original_idea.body: Persona-Induced Honesty Degradation Benchmark. Problem: no benchmark measures how a spectrum of persona prompts shifts factual honesty and self-disclosure across many open models. Direction: define a persona ladder and probe set, measure per persona level the AI-nature disclosure rate and fabrication, output a honesty-vs-persona curve.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: persona-driven honesty erosion is a flagged open problem with concrete deployment harm.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt-only persona ladder + factual probes; no training.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused honesty-vs-persona curve; spanning many models adds some scope.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Prompt-only external audit on open models.

novelty.reasoning: Credential-disclosure persona work exists; spectrum/curve may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Persona honesty audits exist; a graded persona-ladder honesty curve is plausibly open.
